what: On hover the pill button’s fill plate alone presses to .97 over .3s ease (the right icon circle to .94) while the text stays put. On release it springs back on a 1s spring curve (written with linear(), 1.4x overshoot, three wobbles). The tilt type has two stacked fills crossing at +4°/−4° and pressing to .94, and the text also tilts +4°, twisting like a squeezed candy

options.look: When ’tilt’, the two paint layers (bg, back) turn out of step and the text (label) tilts too
options.--fx-press: Scale at which the fill is pressed (css variable), default .97

use: Your button text here · tilt: Shopping

from.where: index.html shop pills, detail links, FAQ buttons, bookmark next button (original :before scale .97 / .icon:before .94, transition .3s ease ↔ 1s linear() spring) · header buy pill (:before −4°, :after +4°, .texts +4°, .94x)

note: The fill (bg) is an empty span inside the button, and that span gets the background color and border — the button itself doesn’t grow, so the text doesn’t shake. On devices without hover it stays as is.
